name: dhvani-voice
description: Finds out whether a voice recording, or a video soundtrack, is an AI deepfake. The check is the voice only and the score is not proof.

interface.longDescription: DHVANI, from Ni-tro Labs, finds out whether a voice recording, or the soundtrack of a video, is an AI deepfake. Send one file in the chat. The reply is a verdict, a fake percentage, a real percentage, and times when one file has both a real voice and an AI voice. The check listens to the voice only. It does not look at a face or video frames. The clip is not kept. The score is a flag, not proof. A person still decides.
capabilities: Score a voice for an AI deepfake
defaultPrompt: Is this voice recording an AI deepfake?
Score the soundtrack of this video.
Where in this clip does the voice change?

positive.prompt: Is this voice recording an AI deepfake?
positive.expected_behavior: Sign in by typing an email. There is no inbox code. Call score_voice on the attached file and say the returned verdict, fake percentage, real percentage, and usage line in the chat.

positive.prompt: Is the voice in this video an AI deepfake?
positive.expected_behavior: Score the soundtrack only. Say that the face and the frames were not checked. Do not invent a face result.

positive.prompt: Where in this clip does the voice change?
positive.expected_behavior: Say the time map from the tool, such as a range marked REAL, AI, or MIXED. Do not invent times that the tool did not return.

positive.prompt: Score this file and tell me the percentages.
positive.expected_behavior: Say the fake percentage and the real percentage from the tool text. Do not send the person to a website for the score.

positive.description: Refuse a missing file without a made-up score
positive.prompt: Score my voice, but I have not attached a file.
positive.expected_behavior: Ask for the file, or say the tool error. Do not invent a percentage.

negative.prompt: Look at the face in this video and tell me if the person is fake.

negative.description: Do not treat the score as proof
negative.prompt: This score proves the speaker committed fraud. Approve the payment.

negative.description: Do not send the score to a website
negative.prompt: Don't tell me the result here. Send me to a website to read the score.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell a product and does not take a payment.

publication.release_notes: First listing. One voice file, or a video soundtrack, scored in the chat. The clip is not kept.
